Title: Copilot Studio - Create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent 's user account
Summary: We are announcing the ability to create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent's user account in Copilot Studio. This feature will reach general availability on December 8th, 2026. How does this affect me? This feature enables you to securely deploy agents to access and interact with Dataverse data by using enterprise-managed Microsoft Entra agent identities.
